item.title: statsmodels vs Pingouin vs SciPy in 2026: Which Python Statistics Library Should You Actually Use?
item.description: You have a DataFrame with two groups, a p-value, and a reviewer asking for the effect size, the confidence interval, and the corrected p-value for the other nine tests you ran. You can chain four scipy.stats calls and hand-roll the corrections — or you can use the one library that returns all of it in a single tidy row.
